quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates HKEX announcement: Revision of Annual Caps for and Renewal of Continuing (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: On 16 September 2026 Kingboard Laminates and its controlling shareholder Kingboard Holdings (KBH; about 62.13% owner, a maker of laminates, PCBs and chemicals) renewed two framework agreements for 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2028, subject to independent shareholders' approval. Supply of laminates and related upstream materials to the KBH Group: 2026 cap revised from HK$4,765,000 thousand to HK$6,941,600 thousand, then HK$8,329,900 thousand (2027) and HK$9,995,900 thousand (2028); actual sales HK$4,096,187 thousand (2024), HK$3,801,834 thousand (2025) and HK$3,702,167 thousand in the eight months to 31 August 2026 (estimated HK$5,553,251 thousand for 2026). Purchase of chemicals (methanol, formalin, phenol, acetone, bisphenol A, caustic soda) from the KBH Group: 2026 cap revised from HK$848,000 thousand to HK$1,174,000 thousand, then HK$1,408,800 thousand (2027) and HK$1,690,600 thousand (2028); actual HK$790,900 thousand (2024), HK$799,753 thousand (2025), HK$626,168 thousand to 31 August 2026. The caps reflect anticipated demand, higher market prices and the expected increase in the KBH Group's PCB production capacity; caps are ceilings, not sales.
